skill_bank_focus.retention_reason: Existing canonical intake/CV aliases, dated trend signals and SDG skill mappings still reference these skills; clinical/coaching skills also occur in current-role profiles. Removing them would break reference history and intake recognition.
skill_bank_focus.importance_policy: Keep surviving relative weights; they are positive and <=1, and matching/pathway aggregate weights are normalized by each role total. No renormalization needed.
skill_bank_focus.digital_health_nurse: Retain target digital focus for qualified nurses; healthcare informatics plus AI literacy, not a nursing qualification.
